metaTitle: How to Choose a Camping Pillow
description: Choose a camping pillow by sleeping position, loft, packed size and material, with a comparison of inflatable, foam, fill and hybrid designs.
directAnswer: Match loft to your position: about 4 to 6 inches for side sleepers, 3 to 4 for back sleepers and 2 or less for stomach sleepers. Inflatables pack smallest, foam feels closest to home, and hybrids sit between.
